page.layout: One printed page of running text in one main column; marginal notes in the left margin (short catchphrases beside lines) and a small note at the right edge. Running head at top with page number.
page.running_head: Justinianus II. Leont. Apsimarus. Lib. IV.

main_text.p: rum ditione condita, everso Altino, Torcellum, exstructum & frequentatum, exundante Brixia, clenfium multitudine Aequilium habitari ceperunt, & in oppidi formam redactum; Mestre maucum aedificiis occupatum est) regebantur Ducem, ad quem a Tribunis provocatio ellet, sibi creavere. Primus Paulutius Anafestus Heraclius erat, quiinito Magistratu, omnia fere recte curaturum, quae pro Reip. dignitate eilent, juravit cum Luitbrando Longobardorum Rege foedus icit, Aequilinos, feu Jefulanos, deficientes, Toritate potiùs quàm armis ad imperium revocavit, & Heraclia fines à majori planicie ad mare usque protulit.

In ANGLIA praefuit CANTIANIS post Justi-Leand. de increm. Reip. Venet.therum, qui in praelio contra Auftrales Saxones cecidit, Edricus & Withredus Fr. OCCIDENTA-LIBUS Saxonibus, post Kenwinum, Cenwalhum, Kenrici * abnepos, & Ina, Kenrici † praefuit ORIENTALIBUS Sigebard & Senfrid * fratres, Offa † Sigeri F. & Selredus * Sigebert, bonis F. NORTHUMBRIS Alfridus † Osredus, Alfridi * F. MERCIIS Kenredus, Wolf feri F. & Cedredus *, Etheludi F. ORIENTALIBUS ANGLIS Beorna †, Ethelberti Filia.

In GALLIA fuccefsere Theodericus, * Ludovicus † Childebertus, & Dagobertus *, Theodoricus adhuc regnante, mortuo Wulfaldo, Majorem Domus in Auftrafia, Pipinus Anfegini F. Princeps cum Duce Martino factus eft. Ebroinus hostis perfecutus in agro Laudunensi fuit. Ebroinus Ermenfridus in lectulo noctu jugulavit, Warnahio, illius fucceffor, cum Pipino gravis rebellio pulcre.

page.notes: Printed page is a dense, partly blurred scan; many words are uncertain and marked by approximation. Marginal notes at left: "Leand. de increm. Reip. Venet.", "Sigebert. in Chronic." Right edge has faint cut-off text, not transcribed. Page shows ink bleed and damage on right side.
